title: Comprehensive molecular characterization of gastric adenocarcinoma.
Molecular analysis of gastric cancer identifies subtypes associated with distinct clinical outcomes.
Dissecting transcriptional heterogeneity in primary gastric adenocarcinoma by single cell RNA sequencing.
Cell-free multi-omics analysis reveals potential biomarkers in gastrointestinal cancer patients' blood.
Molecular characterization and clinical relevance of metabolic signature subtypes in gastric cancer.
Single-cell dissection of intratumoral heterogeneity and lineage diversity in metastatic gastric adenocarcinoma.

evidence_summary: Patient-derived organoids (PDOs) were treated with 5-FU or oxaliplatin; RNA sequencing identified upregulation of tumor suppression genes/pathways in sensitive organoids and enrichment of proliferation/invasion genes in resistant organoids; drug response predictions were validated in patient-derived organoid-based xenograft (PDOX) mice and showed 91.7% concordance with clinical response in gastric cancer patients.
title: Personalized drug screening using patient-derived organoid and its clinical relevance in gastric cancer.

evidence_summary: In vitro and in vivo studies demonstrated PDE5A+ CAFs enhance immunosuppression via PI3K/AKT/mTOR/CXCL12 axis; combined PDE5A inhibitor vardenafil and LAG3 blockade improved immunotherapy response in mouse gastric cancer models.

validated_targets.experimental_detail: PDE5A+ CAFs promoted EMT and immunosuppressive TME; vardenafil (PDE5A inhibitor) combined with LAG3 blockade enhanced immunotherapy response in mouse models.
validated_targets.specific_model_name: gastric cancer mouse models, in vitro cell lines

validated_targets.experimental_detail: LAG3 blockade combined with PDE5A inhibitor vardenafil effectively enhanced immunotherapy responses and suppressed gastric cancer progression in mouse models.
PDE5A+ CAFs triggered PI3K/AKT/mTOR pathway to release CXCL12, promoting immunosuppressive TME.
validated_targets.specific_model_name: gastric cancer in vitro and in vivo models

title: PDE5A<sup>+</sup> cancer-associated fibroblasts enhance immune suppression in gastric cancer.

evidence_summary: FOXP4 loss impaired gastric cancer spheroid formation and stemness marker expression, while FOXP4 upregulation potentiated stemness; a small-molecule inhibitor targeting FOXP4 suppressed tumor growth and enhanced 5-fluorouracil efficacy in vivo.

validated_targets.experimental_detail: Loss of FOXP4 impaired spheroid formation and reduced stemness markers; FOXP4 upregulation potentiated cancer cell stemness; small-molecule inhibitor targeting FOXP4 suppressed gastric tumor growth in vivo.
Functional studies established that SOX12 supports stemness in YAP1-induced gastric carcinogenesis.

title: FOXP4 Is a Direct YAP1 Target That Promotes Gastric Cancer Stemness and Drives Metastasis.

evidence_summary: CST1 overexpression in gastric cancer cells promoted migration, invasion, and EMT in vitro and enhanced liver, lung, and peritoneal metastasis in nude mice; co-immunoprecipitation and mass spectrometry confirmed CST1 interaction with GPX4, and CST1 stabilized GPX4 by recruiting OTUB1 to reduce its ubiquitination, thereby inhibiting ferroptosis.

validated_targets.experimental_detail: Overexpression of CST1 promoted migration, invasion, and epithelial-mesenchymal transition in gastric cancer cells and enhanced liver, lung, and peritoneal metastasis in nude mice.
validated_targets.specific_model_name: gastric cancer cell lines, nude mice, patient peripheral blood and ascites

validated_targets.experimental_detail: CST1 physically interacts with GPX4 and recruits OTUB1 to deubiquitinate and stabilize GPX4, reducing intracellular ROS and inhibiting ferroptosis.

title: CST1 inhibits ferroptosis and promotes gastric cancer metastasis by regulating GPX4 protein stability via OTUB1.

evidence_summary: SOX9 knockout in patient-derived gastric adenocarcinoma cells reduced stemness, tumor formation and metastasis while enhancing CD8+ T cell responses, and LIF was identified as a key paracrine mediator promoting M2 macrophage repolarization and T cell suppression; combined targeting of LIF/LIFR and CSF1R showed therapeutic potential in KP-Luc2 syngeneic models.
validation_methods: co-culture with PBMCs or CD45+ immune cells
in vivo tumor formation and metastasis assays

validated_targets.experimental_detail: SOX9 depletion in patient-derived GAC cells decreased stemness, tumor formation, metastasis and increased CD8+ T cell responses in co-culture with PBMCs/CD45+ cells.
validated_targets.specific_model_name: patient-derived gastric adenocarcinoma cells; KP-Luc2 syngeneic mouse model

validated_targets.experimental_detail: LIF was identified as the top secreted factor regulated by SOX9, enriched in malignant ascites, and mediated SOX9-induced M2 macrophage repolarization and inhibition of T cell function.
validated_targets.specific_model_name: patient-derived gastric adenocarcinoma cells; malignant ascites; co-culture with macrophages and T cells

title: Epithelial SOX9 drives progression and metastases of gastric adenocarcinoma by promoting immunosuppressive tumour microenvironment.

evidence_summary: Conditional Klhl21 knockout in mouse gastric cells promoted proliferation and STAT3 activation, which was reversed by STAT3 inhibitor TTI-101, validating KLHL21 as a tumor suppressor and STAT3 as an oncogenic driver.

validated_targets.experimental_detail: Genetic deletion of Klhl21 in mouse models via conditional knockout enhanced proliferation, STAT3 signaling, and tumorigenicity, while low KLHL21 in patients correlated with poor survival.
validated_targets.specific_model_name: Klhl21-floxed conditional knockout mice, patient gastric tissues

validated_targets.experimental_detail: Pharmacological inhibition of STAT3 using TTI-101 suppressed the transition from metaplasia to dysplasia in Klhl21-deficient stomachs.

title: KLHL21 suppresses gastric tumourigenesis via maintaining STAT3 signalling equilibrium in stomach homoeostasis.

evidence_summary: SMYD5 ablation in mouse models of gastric adenocarcinoma blocked metastasis; SMYD5 depletion combined with PI3K-mTOR inhibition and CAR T cell therapy cured peritoneal carcinomatosis in vivo; SMYD5 and rpL40K22me3 were upregulated in patient samples.

validated_targets.experimental_detail: SMYD5 ablation in familial and sporadic mouse models of malignant GAC blocked metastatic disease; SMYD5 depletion in GAC cell lines reprogrammed protein synthesis to attenuate oncogenic gene expression.
validated_targets.specific_model_name: GAC cell lines, familial and sporadic mouse models of GAC, patient-derived GAC xenografts

validated_targets.experimental_detail: Inhibiting the SMYD5-rpL40K22me3 axis in GAC cell lines reprogrammed protein synthesis; SMYD5 and rpL40K22me3 were upregulated in patient samples and negatively correlated with clinical outcomes.
validated_targets.specific_model_name: GAC cell lines, patient samples, mouse models

title: SMYD5 methylation of rpL40 links ribosomal output to gastric cancer.

evidence_summary: Generation of stomach-specific conditional mutant mice carrying KrasG12D, Tp53R172H, Smad4 deletion, Cdh1 deletion, or Apc deletion induced gastric tumors with distinct histological subtypes, metastatic patterns, and differential drug responses in derived organoids.

validated_targets.experimental_detail: Expression of KrasG12D/+ in stomach epithelium combined with other mutations led to invasive gastric tumors; included in all three mouse models (CIN, GS-TGFB, GS-Wnt).
Tp53R172H/+ mutation in CIN model cooperated to produce glandular gastric tumors with liver and lung metastases.
Homozygous deletion of Smad4 (Smad4fl/fl) in stomach epithelium contributed to invasive CIN and GS-TGFB gastric cancer phenotypes.
Deletion of Cdh1 (Cdh1fl/fl) combined with other mutations resulted in poorly differentiated, diffuse-type gastric tumors with signet ring cells and peritoneal metastases.
Apc deletion (Apcfl/fl) in the stomach combined with Cdh1 and Kras mutations led to adenomatous tooth-like gastric cancer.

title: Mouse Models of Human Gastric Cancer Subtypes With Stomach-Specific CreERT2-Mediated Pathway Alterations.

evidence_summary: Autologous injection of macrophage-derived extracellular vesicles containing NAMPT restored CD8+ T cell cytotoxicity and anti-PD-1 response in a gastric cancer animal model, functionally validating NAMPT as protective and NNMT as oncogenic in nicotinamide metabolism.

validated_targets.experimental_detail: Autologous injection of macrophage-derived extracellular vesicles containing NAMPT restored CD8+ T cell cytotoxicity and anti-PD-1 response in gastric cancer.
NNMT transcriptionally activated by NOTCH/RBP-J and inhibited by NAMPT-containing extracellular vesicles via SIRT1/NICD axis; inhibition of NNMT leads to restoration of CD8+ T cell function.

title: Nicotinamide metabolism face-off between macrophages and fibroblasts manipulates the microenvironment in gastric cancer.

evidence_summary: NR4A1 loss rescued effects of pyrimidine nucleotide stress on gastric cancer cells in vitro and in vivo; co-targeting DNPB and NR4A1 induced synergistic tumor lethality in xenograft models.

validated_targets.experimental_detail: NR4A1 loss rescued pyrimidine nucleotide stress effects on GCa cells; NR4A1 agonists suppressed pyrimidine salvage pathway; co-targeting DNPB and NR4A1 induced synergistic tumor lethality in xenograft models.

title: UMP functions as an endogenous regulator of NR4A1 to control gastric cancer progression.

evidence_summary: Overexpression of CAD or mutation of Asp1371 to block caspase-3 cleavage conferred chemoresistance in xenograft and Cldn18-ATK gastric cancer models; pharmacological targeting of CAD-Asp1371 mutations using RMY-186 ameliorated chemotherapy efficacy; CAD Asp1371 mutations found in chemoresistant patient tumor samples.

validated_targets.experimental_detail: Overexpression of CAD or introduction of Asp1371 mutation to block caspase-3 cleavage conferred chemoresistance in xenograft and Cldn18-ATK gastric cancer models; pharmacological targeting of these mutations with RMY-186 ameliorated chemotherapy efficacy.
validated_targets.specific_model_name: xenograft, Cldn18-ATK gastric cancer models, patient tumor samples

title: Cleavage of CAD by caspase-3 determines the cancer cell fate during chemotherapy.

evidence_summary: Mutagenesis of A. baumannii pncA gene confirmed its NA-dependent pro-metastatic effect in co-culture; in vivo models validated that A. baumannii promotes gastric cancer metastasis via NA-mediated NAD metabolism reprogramming and HIF-1 pathway activation.

validated_targets.experimental_detail: A. baumannii co-culture activated hypoxia-inducible factor-1 pathway in gastric cancer cells along with glycolytic shift, confirmed by in vivo and in vitro experiments.

title: Acinetobacter baumannii promotes gastric cancer metastasis via NA-mediated NAD metabolism reprogramming and glycolytic activation.

evidence_summary: 5-HT and HTR2B agonist enhanced cell viability under metabolic stress, reduced reactive oxygen species and ferroptosis; HTR2B loss/inhibition and antagonist treatment suppressed tumor growth in vitro and in a patient-derived xenograft model; mechanistic studies showed HTR2B cooperates with Fyn to activate PI3K/Akt/mTOR signaling, upregulating HIF1α and ABCD1.
validation_methods: Cell viability assay under metabolic stress

validated_targets.experimental_detail: 5-HT/HTR2B agonist enhanced viability, reduced ROS and ferroptosis; HTR2B loss/inhibition or selective antagonist suppressed tumor growth in vitro and in PDX model; high expression correlated with shorter survival.
validated_targets.specific_model_name: human gastric adenocarcinoma tissues, patient-derived xenograft model, gastric adenocarcinoma cell lines

validated_targets.experimental_detail: Single-cell analysis revealed enrichment of PI3K/Akt/mTOR gene clusters in HTR2B-positive cells; HTR2B cooperated with Fyn to regulate p85 and trigger PI3K/Akt/mTOR signaling.

title: Neurotransmitter Receptor HTR2B Regulates Lipid Metabolism to Inhibit Ferroptosis in Gastric Cancer.

evidence_summary: Transgenic mouse with inducible CLDN18-ARHGAP26 fusion in gastric organoids demonstrated signet ring cell formation and cooperative transformation with Trp53 loss, RHOA/FAK/YAP activation, and combination FAK and YAP-TEAD inhibitor treatment significantly blocked tumor growth.

validated_targets.experimental_detail: Inducible expression of CLDN18-ARHGAP26 fusion in gastric organoids induced signet ring cell formation and cooperatively transformed gastric cells when combined with Trp53 loss.
CLDN18-ARHGAP26 fusion promotes activation of RHOA and downstream effector signalling.
Fusion promotes activation of focal adhesion kinase (FAK); combination of FAK and YAP/TEAD inhibition significantly blocked tumour growth.
Fusion induces YAP pathway; YAP/TEAD inhibitor combined with FAK inhibitor blocked tumour growth.

title: Recurrent RhoGAP gene fusion CLDN18-ARHGAP26 promotes RHOA activation and focal adhesion kinase and YAP-TEAD signalling in diffuse gastric cancer.

evidence_summary: METTL3 overexpression in GC cell lines promoted proliferation and liver metastasis in vitro and in vivo; tissue microarray and IHC showed elevated METTL3 in GC tissues associated with poor prognosis.

validated_targets.experimental_detail: METTL3 overexpression promoted GC cell proliferation and liver metastasis in vitro and in vivo; elevated METTL3 expression was an independent prognostic factor in human GC tissues.

title: METTL3-mediated m<sup>6</sup>A modification of HDGF mRNA promotes gastric cancer progression and has prognostic significance.

evidence_summary: EBV infection in gastric cancer cells upregulated OLFM4 expression through cGAS-STING pathway; microvesicle-carried OLFM4 bound FAT1 extracellular domain, disrupting FAT1-MST1 interaction and activating YAP, thereby promoting tumor progression.

validated_targets.experimental_detail: EBV infection upregulated OLFM4 expression via the cGAS-STING pathway, and microvesicle-carried OLFM4 bound FAT1 to disrupt FAT1-MST1 interaction, leading to YAP activation and tumor progression.
Activation of YAP in recipient cells by microvesicle-mediated OLFM4 delivery, indicating Hippo pathway inhibition and oncogenic signaling.

title: Epstein-Barr virus infection upregulates extracellular OLFM4 to activate YAP signaling during gastric cancer progression.

evidence_summary: EFNA1 overexpression in gastric cancer cells increased CCL2 secretion via Hippo-YAP pathway; CCL2 activated hepatic stellate cells through WNT/β-catenin; CCL2 inhibition suppressed HStC activation and reduced liver metastasis in animal models.

validated_targets.experimental_detail: EFNA1 overexpression in gastric cancer cells significantly increased CCL2 secretion through Hippo-YAP pathway, leading to hepatic stellate cell activation and liver metastasis; CCL2 inhibition suppressed the EFNA1-triggered metastasis.
CCL2 inhibition significantly suppressed hepatic stellate cell activation and reduced liver metastasis triggered by EFNA1 signaling in gastric cancer.
EFNA1 overexpression increased CCL2 secretion through the Hippo-YAP pathway.
Secreted CCL2 activated hepatic stellate cells via the WNT/β-catenin pathway to facilitate premetastatic niche formation.

title: Ephrin A1 Stimulates CCL2 Secretion to Facilitate Premetastatic Niche Formation and Promote Gastric Cancer Liver Metastasis.

evidence_summary: CRISPR knockout of YAP1 eliminated peritoneal metastases in PDO mouse model, and YAP1 inhibitor reduced CSC properties and suppressed tumor growth in PDX model.

validated_targets.experimental_detail: Genetic knockout of YAP1 significantly slowed tumour growth and eliminated peritoneal metastases in PDO model; pharmacologic inhibition reduced CSC-like properties and suppressed tumour growth in PDX model.
validated_targets.specific_model_name: patient-derived xenograft (PDX) and patient-derived orthotopic (PDO) models

title: YAP1 mediates gastric adenocarcinoma peritoneal metastases that are attenuated by YAP1 inhibition.

evidence_summary: Somatic introduction of oncogenic lesions into the murine gastric epithelium generated metastatic gastric cancers recapitulating human subtypes; comparison of wild-type and immunodeficient mice revealed genotype-specific links between organotropism and immune surveillance, validated by histological and molecular analysis.
title: Somatic mouse models of gastric cancer reveal genotype-specific features of metastatic disease.
Multi-omic profiling of peritoneal metastases in gastric cancer identifies molecular subtypes and therapeutic vulnerabilities.
Multiplex profiling of peritoneal metastases from gastric adenocarcinoma identified novel targets and molecular subtypes that predict treatment response.

evidence_summary: VPS35 knockdown and overexpression in gastric cancer cell lines demonstrated promotion of proliferation and metastasis; in vivo xenograft model confirmed tumor-supportive role; mass spectrometry, Co-IP, and ChIP revealed molecular interactions and feedback loop with STAT3.

validated_targets.experimental_detail: VPS35 knockdown suppressed GC cell proliferation, metastasis, and sensitized cells to 5-FU and cisplatin; overexpression promoted proliferation and metastasis through IL-6/STAT3 pathway.
validated_targets.specific_model_name: MGC-803 cell line, gastric cancer patient tissues, xenograft mice

title: VPS35 promotes gastric cancer progression through integrin/FAK/SRC signalling-mediated IL-6/STAT3 pathway activation in a YAP-dependent manner.

evidence_summary: SIRT1 overexpression decreased and knockdown increased H3K18la levels in GC cells; H19 knockdown reduced LDHA and H3K18la, LDHA knockdown impaired H19 and H3K18la, confirming a positive feedback loop; combined SRT2104 and oxamate treatment exerted antitumor effects with limited normal cell toxicity.

validated_targets.experimental_detail: SIRT1 overexpression decreased H3K18la levels and H19 expression, while SIRT1 knockdown increased H3K18la; SIRT1-weak/H3K18la-strong signature was an independent prognostic factor.
H19 knockdown decreased LDHA and H3K18la expression, and H19 was downregulated under SIRT1 overexpression or glucose-free conditions via reduced H3K18la at its promoter.
LDHA knockdown impaired H19 and H3K18la expression, and its inhibitor oxamate combined with SIRT1 activator showed antitumor effects.

title: Delactylase effects of SIRT1 on a positive feedback loop involving the H19-glycolysis-histone lactylation in gastric cancer.

evidence_summary: In vitro and in vivo experiments demonstrated that CLDN18 fusion mutations improve tumor response to paclitaxel treatment in gastric cancer with ovarian metastasis.

validated_targets.experimental_detail: CLDN18 fusion mutations were validated to improve tumor response to paclitaxel in gastric cancer with ovarian metastasis in vitro and in vivo.

title: Mutation characteristics and molecular evolution of ovarian metastasis from gastric cancer and potential biomarkers for paclitaxel treatment.

evidence_summary: Fibrin-targeted 90Y-CM600 treatment in mouse xenograft models of human gastric cancer (SNU-16 and NCI-N87) resulted in decreased tumor growth and prolonged survival, validating fibrin as a therapeutic target.

validated_targets.experimental_detail: 90Y-CM600, a fibrin-targeted beta-emitting peptide, significantly decreased tumor growth and prolonged survival in SNU-16 (fibrin-high) and NCI-N87 (fibrin-low) mouse xenograft models of human gastric cancer.
validated_targets.specific_model_name: SNU-16 and NCI-N87 xenograft mouse models

title: Development of a fibrin-targeted theranostic for gastric cancer.

evidence_summary: Mouse models with conditional expression of KrasG12D, Pik3caH1047R, Pten loss, and Trp53 mutation demonstrated that mutant Trp53 induces an IL-11 to IL-6 dependency switch, and IL-6/STAT3 signaling is a therapeutic vulnerability for TP53-mutant gastric cancer.

validated_targets.experimental_detail: Mutant Trp53-induced IL-11 to IL-6 dependency switch and IL-6/STAT3 signaling identified as a therapeutic vulnerability using knock-in and conditional knockout mouse models of gastric cancer progression and metastasis.
validated_targets.specific_model_name: allelic series of mice with conditional KrasG12D, Pik3caH1047R, Pten deletion, Trp53 loss or Trp53R172H mutation

title: Mutant TP53 switches therapeutic vulnerability during gastric cancer progression within interleukin-6 family cytokines.

evidence_summary: miR-92a-1-5p mimics/inhibitors transfection in gastric cancer cells, along with immunohistochemistry and in situ hybridization on IM tissue microarrays, validated miR-92a-1-5p upregulation, FOXD1/FOXJ1 suppression, CDX2 and NF-κB pathway activation in gastric intestinal metaplasia.
validation_methods: transfection with miRNA mimics and inhibitors

validated_targets.experimental_detail: Transfection of miR-92a-1-5p mimics/inhibitors in gastric cancer cells altered CDX2 and downstream markers; IHC and ISH in IM tissues confirmed high miR-92a-1-5p levels correlated with low FOXD1 and high CDX2.
validated_targets.specific_model_name: gastric cancer cell lines and IM tissue microarrays

validated_targets.experimental_detail: Suppressed by miR-92a-1-5p in gastric cancer cells; low FOXD1 levels in IM tissues confirmed by IHC, with inverse correlation to miR-92a-1-5p.
validated_targets.specific_model_name: gastric cancer cell lines and IM tissue microarrays

validated_targets.experimental_detail: Targeted by miR-92a-1-5p as part of FOXD1/FOXJ1 axis; its suppression linked to CDX2 activation in transfected gastric cancer cells.
validated_targets.specific_model_name: gastric cancer cell lines and IM tissue microarrays

validated_targets.experimental_detail: Activated by miR-92a-1-5p via FOXD1/NF-κB axis in gastric cancer cells; high CDX2 levels in IM tissues correlated with high miR-92a-1-5p.
validated_targets.specific_model_name: gastric cancer cell lines and IM tissue microarrays

validated_targets.experimental_detail: miR-92a-1-5p modulated activation of NF-κB pathway downstream of FOXD1 in gastric cancer cells, contributing to CDX2 induction.
validated_targets.specific_model_name: gastric cancer cell lines and IM tissue microarrays

title: MicroRNA-92a-1-5p increases CDX2 by targeting FOXD1 in bile acids-induced gastric intestinal metaplasia.

evidence_summary: OXTR antagonist Atosiban treatment inhibited OXTR activity, leading to LATS1 phosphorylation and YAP cytoplasmic sequestration, thereby inhibiting gastric cancer progression.

validated_targets.experimental_detail: Inhibition of OXTR by antagonist Atosiban suppressed gastric cancer progression through the Hippo/YAP pathway.

title: The interplay between oxytocin receptor and YAP in regulating gastric cancer progression.
Genomic profile analysis of diffuse-type gastric cancers.

evidence_summary: siRNA screen identified RBM8A, which recruits eIF4A3 to stabilize EGFR mRNA and sustain EGFR-DNA-PKcs complex for NHEJ repair; gefitinib restored oxaliplatin sensitivity in vitro and suppressed RBM8A-driven xenograft growth in vivo; tissue microarrays confirmed dual RBM8A/EGFR overexpression predicts poor survival.

validated_targets.experimental_detail: siRNA screen identified RBM8A as central orchestrator of oxaliplatin-induced DNA damage; functional studies showed it promotes tumor proliferation and chemoresistance by recruiting eIF4A3 to stabilize EGFR mRNA; its overexpression in clinical samples predicts poor survival.
validated_targets.specific_model_name: gastric cancer cell lines, xenograft nude mice, patient tissues

validated_targets.experimental_detail: RBM8A stabilizes EGFR mRNA, sustaining EGFR protein levels which form nuclear complex with DNA-PKcs to drive NHEJ-mediated DNA repair; EGFR inhibitor gefitinib restored sensitivity and suppressed xenograft growth; dual RBM8A/EGFR overexpression predicts poorest survival.
validated_targets.specific_model_name: gastric cancer cell lines, xenograft nude mice, patient tissues

title: RBM8A confers oxaliplatin resistance in gastric cancer by maintaining EGFR mRNA stability.

evidence_summary: NSUN2 promoted ORAI2 expression via m5C modification with YBX1 as reader; fatty acid uptake from adipocytes upregulated E2F1 through AMPK pathway, transcriptionally activating NSUN2 and enhancing peritoneal metastasis of gastric cancer cells.

validated_targets.experimental_detail: NSUN2 expression significantly upregulated in peritoneal metastasis, promotes ORAI2 mRNA stability via m5C modification, enhancing peritoneal metastasis and colonization.
NSUN2-mediated m5C modification stabilizes ORAI2 mRNA, upregulating ORAI2 expression and promoting peritoneal metastasis.
YBX1 acts as a reader by binding to the m5C modification site on ORAI2 mRNA, contributing to ORAI2 stability and peritoneal metastasis promotion.
Fatty acid uptake from omental adipocytes upregulates E2F1, which transcriptionally activates NSUN2 through cis-element, promoting peritoneal metastasis.
AMPK pathway mediates fatty acid-induced elevation of E2F1 and NSUN2, contributing to peritoneal metastasis of gastric cancer.

title: Peritoneal high-fat environment promotes peritoneal metastasis of gastric cancer cells through activation of NSUN2-mediated ORAI2 m5C modification.

evidence_summary: Metformin treatment of gastric cancer cell lines and PDX models reduced proliferation, tumoursphere formation, and in vivo tumour growth, with decreased expression of CSC markers CD44 and Sox2 and increased differentiation markers KLF4 and MUC5AC.

validated_targets.experimental_detail: Metformin treatment decreased CD44 expression, confirming reduction of gastric cancer stem cell markers.
validated_targets.specific_model_name: MKN45, AGS, MKN74 cell lines, patient-derived primary tumour xenografts (PDXs)

validated_targets.experimental_detail: Metformin treatment decreased Sox2 expression, confirming reduction of gastric cancer stem cell markers.
validated_targets.specific_model_name: MKN45, AGS, MKN74 cell lines, patient-derived primary tumour xenografts (PDXs)

validated_targets.experimental_detail: Metformin treatment increased KLF4 expression, indicating promotion of differentiation.
validated_targets.specific_model_name: MKN45, AGS, MKN74 cell lines, patient-derived primary tumour xenografts (PDXs)

validated_targets.experimental_detail: Metformin treatment increased MUC5AC expression, indicating promotion of differentiation.
validated_targets.specific_model_name: MKN45, AGS, MKN74 cell lines, patient-derived primary tumour xenografts (PDXs)

title: Metformin targets gastric cancer stem cells.

evidence_summary: Gain- and loss-of-function experiments showed hsa_circ_0000437 regulates GC cell proliferation, invasion, migration and apoptosis via SRSF3/PDCD4 axis; xenograft model confirmed tumor growth promotion; exosomal hsa_circ_0000437 transferred into HLECs promoted lymphangiogenesis and LNM in popliteal LNM model; clinical serum exosome analysis associated with LNM.

validated_targets.experimental_detail: hsa_circ_0000437 regulated GC cell proliferation, invasion, migration and apoptosis by targeting SRSF3 and inhibiting PDCD4; ectopic expression promoted tumor growth in nude mice; exosomal hsa_circ_0000437 promoted HLEC invasion, migration, tube formation and lymph node metastasis in vivo via HSPA2-ERK pathway.

title: Hsa_circ_0000437 promotes pathogenesis of gastric cancer and lymph node metastasis.

evidence_summary: RNF81 overexpression in gastric cancer cells suppressed proliferation, migration, and invasion in vitro and reduced tumor growth in vivo; KLF4 knockdown partially rescued these tumor-suppressive effects, and KDM1A-E2F1 complex represses RNF81 by reducing H3K4me1/2 at its promoter.

validated_targets.experimental_detail: Overexpression of RNF81 suppressed GC cell proliferation, migration, and invasion in vitro and reduced tumor growth in vivo; KLF4 knockdown partially rescued these effects.
KLF4 knockdown partially rescued the tumor-suppressive effects of RNF81 overexpression in GC cells.

title: KDM1A-driven RNF81 downregulation promotes gastric cancer progression via KLF4 destabilization.
Gastric Cancer CAR T-cell Target Antigen ID'd.

evidence_summary: Knockdown of GAGE12 gene family inhibited trans-well migration, tumor sphere formation in vitro and tumor growth in vivo; overexpression augmented migration, tumor sphere formation and sustained in vivo tumor growth, confirming its role in gastric carcinoma growth and metastasis.

validated_targets.experimental_detail: Knockdown of GAGE12 inhibited migration, tumor sphere formation, in vivo tumor growth and transcription of metastasis-related DEGs; overexpression promoted migration, tumor sphere formation and sustained tumor growth.

title: GAGE12 mediates human gastric carcinoma growth and metastasis.

evidence_summary: In vivo spontaneous lung cancer metastasis model demonstrated that CIC inactivation relieves repression of ETV4, causing ETV4-mediated MMP24 upregulation necessary and sufficient for metastasis.

validated_targets.experimental_detail: Inactivation of CIC in an in vivo spontaneous lung cancer metastasis model drives metastasis; loss of CIC is a biomarker of progression.
CIC inactivation relieves repression of ETV4, which then upregulates MMP24 and promotes metastasis.
ETV4-mediated upregulation of MMP24 is necessary and sufficient for metastasis in the in vivo model.

title: Inactivation of Capicua drives cancer metastasis.

evidence_summary: Proteasome inhibitors induced RAP2 ubiquitination and inactivation, disrupting the RAP2-MAP4Ks-NF2-LATS1/2 pathway to activate YAP/TAZ; pharmacological blockade of YAP/TAZ resensitized solid tumor cells to proteasome inhibitors, and combined inhibition suppressed diffuse-type gastric cancer growth in vivo.

validated_targets.experimental_detail: Proteasome inhibition caused RAP2 ubiquitination and loss of function, relieving suppression of YAP1 through the Hippo pathway; YAP1 activation promoted cell survival and drug resistance; YAP/TAZ blockade restored proteasome inhibitor sensitivity in solid tumor cells.
validated_targets.specific_model_name: Solid tumor cell lines and diffuse-type gastric cancer xenograft

validated_targets.experimental_detail: WWTR1 (TAZ) is co-activated with YAP1 via the RAP2-MAP4Ks-LATS1/2 axis upon proteasome stress; combined YAP/TAZ inhibition overcame proteasome inhibitor resistance and reduced tumor growth in vivo.
validated_targets.specific_model_name: Solid tumor cell lines and diffuse-type gastric cancer xenograft

title: Proteasome stress activates YAP/TAZ through the RAP2-MAP4Ks-LATS1/2 pathway and its therapeutic implications in solid tumors.
journal: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences of the United States of America

title: Study Offers Insights into Gastric Cancer.

evidence_summary: MIR181A1HG upregulation in gastric cancer was confirmed by qPCR, Western blot, IHC, and RNA ISH; functional assays and animal models demonstrated its oncogenic role in promoting invasion, metastasis, and EMT via ELAVL1 stabilization and a SOCS3/NFATC2 feedback loop.

validated_targets.experimental_detail: MIR181A1HG is upregulated in gastric cancer tissues and cells, promotes EMT, invasion, and metastasis through physical interaction with ELAVL1, and its oncogenic function was validated in vitro and in vivo.

SOCS3 mRNA is destabilized by miR-181a-5p/miR-181b-5p; downregulated SOCS3 enhances NFATC2-mediated transcriptional activation of MIR181A1HG, and its protein interaction with NFATC2 was validated by co-immunoprecipitation.

title: Long non-coding RNA-MIR181A1HG acts as an oncogene and contributes to invasion and metastasis in gastric cancer.
Hepcidin levels and gastric cancer risk in the EPIC-EurGast study.

evidence_summary: Co-immunoprecipitation showed SNX5-LRP5 interaction; internalization and recycling assays demonstrated SNX5 inhibits LRP5 endocytosis and promotes membrane recycling, preventing lysosomal degradation; Western blot confirmed β-catenin stabilization and Wnt pathway activation.

validated_targets.experimental_detail: SNX5 is highly expressed in gastric cancer and promotes malignant biological behavior; it interacts with LRP5, inhibits LRP5 internalization, promotes membrane recycling, prevents lysosomal degradation, and activates Wnt/β-catenin pathway.
SNX5-mediated increase in LRP5 membrane localization leads to β-catenin stabilization and activation of Wnt signaling, driving tumorigenesis.

title: SNX5 facilitates the progression of gastric cancer by increasing the membrane localization of LRP5.

evidence_summary: shRNA-mediated knockdown and specific agonists of FPR3 in macrophages validated its role in regulating proliferation and polarization essential for TAM formation; mechanistic studies showed upregulation of FZD7 and CCDC88C activating Wnt/PCP/JNK pathway.

validated_targets.experimental_detail: shRNA-mediated knockdown and specific agonists in macrophages revealed FPR3 regulates macrophage proliferation and polarization, essential for TAM formation and maintenance.

title: FPR3 sustains the immunosuppression of tumor-associated macrophages and accelerates the progression of gastric adenocarcinoma.

evidence_summary: EphA2 interacts with and phosphorylates YAP, leading to YAP stabilization and nuclear translocation; YAP knockdown blocks EphA2-induced tumor growth in GC xenograft models; clinical co-activation of EphA2 and YAP is manifested in human GC and linked to recurrence.

validated_targets.experimental_detail: EphA2 interacts with and phosphorylates YAP, stabilizing YAP and promoting its nuclear translocation; YAP knockdown suppresses EphA2-driven xenograft tumor growth; clinical co-activation in GC tissues correlates with recurrence.

title: EphA2-to-YAP pathway drives gastric cancer growth and therapy resistance.
Genetic features of multicentric/multifocal intramucosal gastric carcinoma.
A novel high-risk subpopulation identified by CTSL and ZBTB7B in gastric cancer.

evidence_summary: S. anginosus conditioned medium promoted GC cell proliferation, invasion, migration and inhibited apoptosis in vitro, and aggravated gastric inflammation and mucus metaplasia in vivo; succinate was identified as the functional metabolite; SUCNR1 knockdown or inhibitor treatment reversed succinate-induced tumor-promoting effects.

validated_targets.experimental_detail: Knockdown of SUCNR1 or treatment with SUCNR1 inhibitors inhibited the tumor-promoting effect of succinate in GC cells

title: Streptococcus anginosus-generated succinate promotes the progression of gastric cancer via the succinate/SUCNR1/ABRAXAS1 axis.

evidence_summary: Loss-of-function mutation of E-cadherin in diffuse gastric cancer cells increased ferroptosis sensitivity; patient-derived single nucleotide mutations reversed E-cadherin's ferroptosis suppression in cell culture and xenograft models.

validated_targets.experimental_detail: Loss-of-function mutation of CDH1 in DGC cells increased ferroptosis sensitivity; mutations abrogating homophilic binding reversed ferroptosis suppression in cell culture and xenograft models.

title: E-cadherin is a biomarker for ferroptosis sensitivity in diffuse gastric cancer.
Development and validation of a prognostic and predictive 32-gene signature for gastric cancer.

evidence_summary: CircPDIA4 depletion enhanced gastric cancer cell sensitivity to ERK inhibitors; elevated expression promoted distant metastasis in mouse xenograft models and accelerated invasion in vitro.

evidence_summary: CircUSP1 overexpression/knockdown in gastric cancer cells was validated to promote growth and metastasis; co-immunoprecipitation and Western blot confirmed HuR binding and stabilization; downstream targets USP1 and Vimentin were functionally validated by post-transcriptional regulation and cell viability/mobility assays; clinical tissue/plasma samples were used for biomarker evaluation.

Vimentin (VIM) was upregulated by HuR at the post-transcriptional level and mediated the effects of circUSP1 on gastric cancer progression.

title: CircUSP1 as a novel marker promotes gastric cancer progression via stabilizing HuR to upregulate USP1 and Vimentin.
